Unchecked totalDeposit += _usdValue and per-token counters can silently overflow (Solidity 0.6, no SafeMath).
poolindex[_tokenSymbol]-1 used as an array index without guarding against zero, causing underflow and out-of-range access.
amountLeft -= openOrderMap[...].amount and amountLeft -= iOrder.amount are unchecked and can underflow.
Monthly due math multiplies by 30 days and divides by 3155695200 without SafeMath.
users[..].deposits[_tokenSymbol] -= _amount and totalDeposit/totalBorrowed arithmetic are unchecked.
userAddress.transfer(amount) sends ETH to a caller-influenced address inside an external manager call path.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) performs an arbitrary low-level call from the contract.
abacus.scheduleFunc{value: callCost} sends ETH to an external oracle contract; failure or refund logic is not handled.
abacus.scheduleFunc{value: callCost} sends ETH to an external oracle contract for the due check callback.
EMM.DepositManager{value: msg.value} forwards arbitrary ETH to an external manager contract.
rtoken.transferFrom(userAddress, address(this), amount) calls an arbitrary token contract without reentrancy protection.
approve followed by transferFrom on an arbitrary token is a reentrancy/approval-race vector.
amount*fetchTokenPrice(_token)/(10**8)/decimals computed with raw operators on oracle-supplied values.
delete users[..].myOrders[_orderId] and borrowedOrders/createdOrders use the order id as an array index, deleting the wrong element or reverting.
mystorage.pop() mutates a storage array while iterating it from length-1 downwards, allowing record loss.
wToken.balanceOf(msgSender) + EDM.getECOEarnings(msgSender) is used as the authorisation basis for payout and calls into the data manager.
getbuyPower * CDSpercent / 100 compared with amount * price / 1e8 uses unchecked raw arithmetic from external calls.
Lock state is toggled through an external Init call, so lock enforcement depends on another contract.
EMM.mintECO(matchOrderMap[_orderId].supplier, due*(100-Init.rewardFee())/100) mints rewards from unchecked math.
poolSorter writes into temp, an unallocated memory array, so writes are lost and orderpool is overwritten with garbage.
msg.sender used as the caller identity in all Ecocelium external entry points.
msg.sender checked only against Init.friendlyaddress in the data manager entry points.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter only feeds the Deposit entry logic and its wrapped-token mint/lock effects.
The amount parameter is consumed entirely inside Withdraw balance and eligibility checks.
msgSender is only used to burn ECO from the paying borrower inside payDue.
The order id parameter is used solely to look up and clear matchOrderMap inside orderExpired.
amountLeft is the loop accumulator that drives the matching loop in newOrder.
The _status boolean only selects the deposit or borrow branch of freePusher.
The symbol parameter only selects which stacked records freePopper consumes.
dues is the accumulator returned by freePopper and is not needed as a separate node.
The amount parameter is only used in the ETH/token payout performed by WithdrawManager.
token2amount is a temporary output value of the swap computation in SwapWrapToWrap.
